integrity: Original analytic argument accompanied by bounded independent numerical verification; no external or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Positive iid stable diffusivity redrawn deterministically; fixed planar wedge and absorbing rays; no correlated/tempered rates or partial absorption. Strongest exact finite-time arctangent formulas only for alpha=1/2 in half-plane/quadrant. Sampled detection uses freely evolving trajectories, not a killed diffusion. Some closely related full texts were unavailable; publication priority remains qualified. Broader 2019 integrated-diffusivity first-passage framework was accessible in abstract only; it may imply portions of the subordination result.
title: Geometry and observation cadence in first passage with stable diffusivity bursts
